title: oily green British lentils Dal
description: a traditional British-inspired lentil curry made with green lentils, aromatic spices, and a rich tadka. this comforting dish is perfect for a sick day or a cozy night in.

ingredients.name: green lentils
ingredients.notes: red or brown lentils can also be used, but green lentils will yield the best results.

ingredients.name: ginger
ingredients.notes: you can use fresh or dried ginger.

ingredients.name: ghee or oil
ingredients.notes: you can use any neutral-tasting oil or ghee.

ingredients.name: mustard oil
ingredients.notes: optional, but recommended for the authentic flavor.

ingredients.name: water
ingredients.notes: you can use vegetable or chicken broth if you prefer.

instructions: heat 1 tsp of ghee or oil in a large pan over medium heat.
add the cumin seeds and let them sizzle for a few seconds.
add the onion and saut2 the until it's translucent and beginning to brown.
add the ginger and saut2 for 1 minute, until fragrant.
add the cumin, coriander, turmeric, and chili powder, and saut2 for 1 minute, until the spices are fragrant.
add the lentils, water, and salt, and bring the mixture to a boil.
reduce the heat to low and let the dal simmer for 20-25 minutes, or until the lentils are tender.
while the dal is cooking, prepare the tadka by heating the remaining 1 tsp of ghee or oil in a small pan over medium heat.
add the mustard oil and let it heat for a few seconds.
add the tadka to the dal and stir well to combine.
serve the dal hot, garnished with chopped fresh cilantro if desired.
taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
